title: COBRA continuation coverage - basics
facts: Federal COBRA can allow workers and family members to temporarily continue employer group health coverage after certain qualifying events that would otherwise cause loss of coverage.

COBRA generally applies to private-sector group health plans maintained by employers with at least 20 employees and to many state and local government plans; separate rules apply to federal employees and some other plans.
Termination of employment other than for gross misconduct or a reduction in hours can be a qualifying event if it causes loss of plan coverage.
COBRA beneficiaries generally receive the same coverage available to similarly situated active participants under the plan.
